dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: That I'd like to do? Why are you asking?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Because I want to accompany you.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: If that's the case, then let me teach you how to dance. Specifically, the "Dance of Sacrifice."

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: I told you, I've incorporated dance into my swordplay. If you want to learn my sword techniques, you'll need to learn to dance first.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Actually, dance is also my favorite artistic pastime...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: It's time for you to learn.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Practice your basic dance steps first, then we'll talk.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Such avarice. I ought to reserve the darkest and most grievous of vengeance for you...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: But thinking about it... Since we're already this far, then I'll turn a blind eye to any new grievance.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: After all, my vengeance for you runs deep... It has long been inextricable.

choices.text: If I step on your feet...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Then I ought to reserve the darkest and most grievous of vengeance for you...
